facts.fact: CPJ says Egypt has blocked outlets since 2017, most recently Zawia3, whose site is blocked inside Egypt.
CPJ says an in absentia conviction in 2024 sentenced Mada Masr's Lina Attalah to one year for disseminating false news and operating an unlicensed website.

note: The 27 October 2026 closure and fine of Mada Masr were for an unlicensed website, not stated as for what it published.
